name: WF-Absence-Notification
description: Receives attendance data via webhook. For each student marked Absent today, resolves the guardian email and sends an absence notification via Gmail. Prevents duplicate notifications per student+batch+date.

input.to: {% set recipients = [] %}{% for e in step_1['emails'] %}{% set _ = recipients.push(e.guardianEmail) %}{% endfor %}{{ recipients | join(',') }}
input.subject: Attendance Notification — {{step_1['emails'][0]['studentName'] || 'Students'}}
input.body: {% if step_1['emails'][0] %}{{step_1['emails'][0]['body']}}{% else %}No absent students to notify.{% endif %}
